email.intro: Enter your email. We'll send you a one-time code — no password.
email.sendFailed: Couldn't send code. Check your connection and try again.
email.title: Sign in

emergencyKit.ackText: I've saved my recovery key in a safe place.
emergencyKit.intro: This key is the only way to add Pollis to a new device or recover after losing this one. We don't store it anywhere you can read it later — write it down or save it to a password manager now.
emergencyKit.title: Save your recovery key
emergencyKit.warning: Anyone with this key can sign in as you on a new device. Treat it like a master password.

enrollment.chooserIntro: This device doesn't have your keys yet. Choose how to get them onto it.
enrollment.pollingIntro: On a device that's already signed in, open Self → Security and approve the request with the code below.
enrollment.recoveryIntro: Paste the recovery key you saved when you first signed up. It looks like a long string of letters and numbers.
enrollment.rejected: The other device rejected this request.

initializing.intro: One moment — pairing your device and syncing keys.
initializing.title: Setting up

otp.sentTo: We sent a 6-digit code to <address>{{email}}</address>. Enter it to continue.
otp.title: Check your email

pin.createIntro: Used to unlock Pollis on this device. This stays on your phone — we never see it.
pin.noActiveUser: No active user. Sign in again.
pin.unlockIntro: Enter your device PIN to unlock encrypted local data.

dm.exactMatchHint: Type at least two characters. Exact match only — Pollis doesn't broadcast partial matches.

discover.blurb: Slugs are short, unique identifiers chosen by group owners. Ask for one to join — there's no public directory.
discover.title: Discover

emoji.adminsOnly: Only group admins can add or remove emoji.

invite.blurb: They'll see this invite in their Pending section the next time they open Pollis. Only admins of {{name}} can invite — if you're not one, the server will reject this.
invite.linkBlurb: Anyone with the link can join directly — no approval step. The link is shown exactly once, right after you create it.
invite.linkOnce: This is the only time this link can be shown. Nobody — including you — can view it again. To share it later, create a new one.

inviteLinks.blurb: Links can't be shown again after creation — the server keeps only a hash. Revoking stops a link immediately for everyone holding it.
inviteLinks.empty: No invite links yet. Create one from the Invite screen.
inviteLinks.title: Invite links

new.blurb: A #General text channel is created automatically. You can add more later. Group metadata is visible to invited members only.

settings.notAdmin: You don't have admin permissions for this group.

groups.empty: No groups yet. Create one to get started.

invite.failed: This invite link can't be used. It may be invalid, expired, revoked, or already used up — ask for a new link.
invite.locked: Unlock Pollis first, then open the invite link again.
invite.signedOut: Sign in to Pollis first, then open the invite link again.
invite.title: Invite

language.restartRequired: Restart Pollis to switch the layout direction.

search.hint: Type at least two characters to search groups, channels, people, and messages.

changeEmail.enterCodeIntro: Enter the code we sent to {{email}}.
changeEmail.enterEmailIntro: Enter the new email. We'll send a 6-digit code to confirm you own it.
changeEmail.title: Change email

deleteAccount.consequences: This permanently deletes your Pollis account. You are removed from every group and conversation, your devices are unregistered, and your encrypted data on this phone is wiped. Other members keep their own copies of past messages, but nothing sent after deletion can ever be read with your keys.
deleteAccount.failed: Couldn't delete the account. Nothing was changed — try again.
deleteAccount.irreversible: This cannot be undone. There is no grace period and no recovery.
deleteAccount.title: Delete account

preferences.notificationsOn: On — new messages will notify you
preferences.readReceiptsSub: Reciprocal — turning this off also hides others' receipts from you

saved.empty: No saved messages. Use the long-press action on a message to save it.

security.autoLockDescription: Lock Pollis behind your device PIN after a period of inactivity. This setting stays on this phone.
security.deleteAccountSub: Permanently delete your account and wipe this device
security.eventsEmpty: No security events yet. Device pairings, revocations, and identity resets will show up here.
security.identityDescription: Your public identity key. Peers you talk to can compare this against what their device sees to verify it's really you.
security.identityMissing: No identity key published from this device yet.
security.lockNowSub: Require your PIN to reopen Pollis
security.pairHint: Confirm this code matches what's shown on the other device, then approve.
security.pairIntro: A new device wants to pair with your account.
security.recoveryDescription: Recovery key and device PIN management aren't wired on mobile yet. To set up a new device, sign in with your email — Pollis walks you through enrollment.

userSettings.avatarHint: Derived from your handle's first two characters.
userSettings.handleHint: Other members can find and DM you with @handle.

user.compareHint: Compare these digits in person or over an out-of-band channel. Matching numbers prove you're talking to the same key the server published for this user.
user.keyChanged: Key changed since you last verified — re-verify in person.
user.selfNote: This is you. Edit your handle and display name in <link>Self → User settings</link>.
user.title: User
